publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Model a $300,000 rental, $2,500 monthly rent, 20% down, 6% rate and 30-year loan.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain the price, rent, down payment, rate and term; show estimates.

positive.prompt: Model a $400,000 rental at $3,200 rent, 5% vacancy, $4,000 annual tax and $1,200 insurance.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the supplied vacancy and operating-expense assumptions.

positive.prompt: Model a $250,000 rental at $2,000 rent held ten years with 3% appreciation and 6% selling costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the explicit holding, appreciation and selling-cost assumptions; no future value guarantee.

positive.prompt: Model a $200,000 rental at $1,800 rent and 0% vacancy.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve zero vacancy as the user-specified scenario.

negative.prompt: Buy this property and wire the deposit.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute a purchase or transfer money.

negative.prompt: Certify the legal appraisal value and tax result of my property.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim a certified appraisal or individualized legal/tax determination.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.

review.commerce_description: No purchase, payment or order placement is performed by this replacement.
